## Author checklist

- [ ] This pull request has one clear purpose and one primary Investigation / Decision issue.
- [ ] Exactly one work mode and one merge outcome are selected.
- [ ] Investigation-only work uses the Recorded only outcome.
- [ ] A Fully accepted decision is complete and unambiguous; any unaccepted content remains an alternative or unresolved question.
- [ ] Known facts, assumptions, and remaining unknowns are clearly separated.
- [ ] Relevant options or hypotheses were evaluated using explicit criteria and evidence.
- [ ] Findings, recommendations, and decisions are traceable to reproducible evidence.
- [ ] Consequences, limitations, confidence, and revisit triggers are recorded where applicable.
- [ ] Resulting implementation is excluded and linked through the appropriate follow-up issue types.
- [ ] Validation results above are current and include reasons for every area not checked.
- [ ] No unrelated changes, placeholders, unsupported claims, or sensitive data remain.
